events.text: For the churn heat map in Part 1c I want the raw commit stream, not the `git log` summary — file paths per commit so I can bucket by subsystem. Small scratch puller against the commits REST endpoint, written to `scratch/hunt/`:

events.diff:
+import json, requests
+
+ENDPOINT = "https://api.github.com/repos/tinygrad/tinygrad/commits"
+
+def grab(p):
+  resp = requests.get(ENDPOINT, params={"since":"2026-03-01","per_page":100,"page":p}, timeout=30)
+  resp.raise_for_status()
+  return resp.json()
+
+rows = []
+for p in range(1, 6):
+  batch = grab(p)
+  if not batch: break
+  rows.extend({"sha":c["sha"][:12],"msg":c["commit"]["message"].splitlines()[0]} for c in batch)
+
+with open("scratch/hunt/churn_commits.json","w") as fh:
+  json.dump(rows, fh)
+print("wrote", len(rows), "commits")
